messages: Build "Repro Suite": a company-style hub website that sits above five of our apps so visitors can open any of them from one place. Static content, no database, no keys. Hero: "Does the research claim really hold?" with a short line and two buttons (Explore the tools, Watch the demo). Main section: five cards (name, one line, who it is for, Open button): Paper Repro Agent https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world ; Repro Lite https://reprolite-aiid.pub.atoms.world ; Reading Companion https://readingcompanion-aiid.pub.atoms.world ; IndexBoard https://indexboard-aiid.pub.atoms.world ; Repro Desk https://reprodesk-aiid.pub.atoms.world . Open in a new tab. English and Chinese toggle, light and dark mode, calm blue and neutral design, serif headline, no emoji, no horizontal scroll at 390px.
The requirements are clear, so I'll start by setting up the frontend template.
I'll read the template README and the context file before coding.
I'll check the existing styling config before writing the design and page.
I'm writing the design spec, theme tokens, the bilingual hub page, and the architecture notes now.
Lint and build passed, so I'll check the page rendering next.

The Repro Suite hub page is built. Lint and the production build pass, and a desktop rendering check showed the layout and content as specified. I haven't checked the 390px mobile width on screen; the layout is written to stack into one column and wrap so there's no sideways scroll.

- **Hero:** the serif headline "Does the research claim really hold?", a short line, and the two buttons. Next to it is a numbered list of the five tools, and each name links straight to that app.
- **Tool cards:** five cards for Paper Repro Agent, Repro Lite, Reading Companion, IndexBoard and Repro Desk. Each has the name, one line, who it's for, and an Open button. All links open in a new tab.
- **Toggles:** an EN/中文 language switch and a light/dark mode button in the header. The page remembers both choices on return visits.
- **Look:** calm blue and neutral colours with a serif for headings. No emoji.

**Check these before publishing:**
- **"Watch the demo":** you didn't give a demo link, so for now this button opens Paper Repro Agent in a new tab. Send me the real demo URL and I'll swap it in.
- **Card text:** I wrote each tool's one-line description and "who it's for" line myself, in English and Chinese. Please make sure they match what your apps actually do.

You can preview it in App Viewer, then click Publish to deploy and share the link.
The page passed the rendering check, so I'm wrapping up.
